description: This Java source file defines the class TopicParseException, a custom exception used when parsing a topic string fails within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity model. It includes builder methods, JSON serialization support, and references to external classes related to exceptions, headers, and JSON handling.

classes.name: TopicParseException
classes.description: A final class extending DittoRuntimeException, representing an exception thrown when a topic string cannot be parsed.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A static inner class providing a fluent API to construct instances of TopicParseException, with thread safety annotations.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Static method to create a new Builder instance with a parsed filter string, optionally with a description hint.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates a TopicParseException from a message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a TopicParseException from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Overrides headers in the exception, returning a new exception instance with updated headers.
